summary: Unified Iframe Engine Bridge with automatic attachment dependency resolution. Loads and runs standard HTML/JS attachments inside an isolated iframe, extracting low-latency GPU canvas frames using VideoFrame and routing Web Audio Context audio outputs directly to Cables.gl.

ports.name: HTML Attachment
ports.text: Name of the main HTML file (default: index.html) loaded from the 'Files' list slots.

ports.name: Files
ports.text: Dynamic multiport string slots. Paste your code inside them and rename the parameter titles in the inspector to represent their virtual filenames (e.g. index.html, sketch.js, cablesBridge.js).

ports.name: Reload
ports.text: Click this button to manually recompile and load code changes into the iframe, preventing automatic refreshes on every keystroke.

ports.name: Iframe ID
ports.text: The DOM ID attribute set on the iframe element (useful for targeted CSS styling or query selector lookup).

ports.name: Target Object Scope
ports.text: Path to the target object inside the iframe to write variables to (e.g., 'window' or 'p5.instance').

ports.name: Broadcast Channel
ports.text: BroadcastChannel name used for IPC to set variables in the iframe.

ports.name: Show UI
ports.text: Toggle visibility of the HTML iframe overlay in the Cables workspace.

ports.name: Width
ports.text: Pixel width of the iframe container.

ports.name: Height
ports.text: Pixel height of the iframe container.

ports.name: Position X
ports.text: X coordinate in pixels for the iframe position.

ports.name: Position Y
ports.text: Y coordinate in pixels for the iframe position.

ports.name: Position Z
ports.text: CSS z-index parameter set on the iframe UI overlay (controls layer layering with editor panes).

ports.name: Opacity
ports.text: CSS opacity of the iframe element (0.0 to 1.0).

ports.name: Flip Y
ports.text: Flips the Y axis of the frame during WebGL texture upload.

ports.name: Texture Out
ports.text: Native Cables CGL.Texture object populated directly with GPU frames from the iframe's canvas.

ports.name: Texture Updated
ports.text: Trigger fired whenever a new GPU frame has been successfully uploaded to the texture.

ports.name: Audio Node Out
ports.text: Web Audio API AudioNode capturing and forwarding all Web Audio output from the iframe.

ports.name: Iframe Element
ports.text: Reference to the created HTMLIframeElement.

ports.name: Message Out
ports.text: Outputs the last message received from the iframe over the BroadcastChannel.

ports.name: Message Received
ports.text: Trigger fired whenever a new message is received from the iframe over the BroadcastChannel.

changelog.message: Initial release of the Unified Iframe Engine Bridge operator with HTML attachment support, WebCodecs VideoFrame zero-copy GPU texture streaming, BroadcastChannel IPC, and prototype-level WebAudio capture.
changelog.author: Cables Studio

changelog.message: Added Iframe ID input port for custom DOM element mapping.
changelog.author: Cables Studio

changelog.message: Added Message Out and Message Received ports to enable bi-directional BroadcastChannel communications.
changelog.author: Cables Studio

changelog.message: Added Position Z input port to allow user control of the iframe DOM z-index.
changelog.author: Cables Studio
